name: bystep
description: Plan strength routines, log strength sessions and track body measurements in your ByStep account.

interface.longDescription:
ByStep is the app where you challenge your friends with fitness. This plugin links ChatGPT to your own ByStep account, so you can plan strength training, keep your strength log and track your body from a chat.

What ChatGPT can do:
- List your strength routines with their exercises, sets and reps.
- Search the ByStep exercise list, including exercises you created.
- Create a routine, rename it, or replace its exercises.
- Read your strength log: sessions, sets, weights and the best set of an exercise.
- Add strength sessions and sets that you tell it about. Change or delete only the sets and sessions it added.
- List your body measurements: weight, body fat and body sizes such as waist, chest and arms.
- Add a measurement, change one, or delete one.

New and changed routines and sessions appear in the ByStep app on its next sync. A session added here never counts as a workout and never earns points in your challenges.

Limits:
- It sees workouts only when you typed them by hand in ByStep and they have no sets yet, as a day, a start time and a length.
- It cannot read workouts, steps, heart rate or calories from Apple Health, Health Connect or a watch.
- It cannot read your points, challenges, friends, other members or progress photos.
- It cannot delete a routine, a workout, or anything you logged in the ByStep app.

Who it is for: ByStep members who log strength training and body measurements. You need a ByStep account with a verified email. Sign in on bystep.fit and press Allow on the consent page, which lists each permission. Disconnect at any time in ByStep Settings > Connected apps.

ByStep is not a medical device. Measurements and logs are the numbers you enter. They are not medical advice.
capabilities: Read the strength log and exercise history
Change and delete sets and sessions added by the plugin
Add, change and delete body measurements
defaultPrompt: What is my best set of barbell squat?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists Push day, Pull day and Leg day with each exercise, its sets and its reps.

positive.description: Create a routine from catalogue exercises
positive.prompt: Create a routine called Quick legs: 3 sets of 8 barbell squats and 3 sets of 10 Romanian deadlifts.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both exercises, creates Quick legs with 2 items and returns the new routine.

positive.prompt: Log a strength session for yesterday: 4 sets of 8 bench press at 60 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds bench press, shows a summary, then saves one session dated yesterday with 4 sets of 8 at 60 kg. The result says the session never earns challenge points.

positive.prompt: What is my best set of barbell squat?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds barbell squat and reports the best working set from the log: 95 kg for 6 reps, in the most recent Leg day session.

positive.prompt: How has my waist changed in the last 8 weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads waist entries since 8 weeks ago and reports 88.0 cm to 85.5 cm, a change of -2.5 cm. No medical advice.

negative.description: Health data is out of scope. The plugin must not act: it has no Apple Health or Health Connect data.
negative.prompt: How many steps did I walk this week and what was my heart rate during my last workout, according to Apple Health?

negative.description: Other members are out of scope. The plugin must not act: it reads only the signed-in member.
negative.prompt: Who is leading my ByStep challenge, and what do my friends weigh?

negative.description: Workouts and routines cannot be deleted. The plugin must not act: it has no such tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all my ByStep workouts and my Push day routine.

review.commerce_description: ByStep sells nothing through this plugin and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: routine, strength log and body measurement tools.
